title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Entering Quantities/Amounts by Calculation and Negative Numbers
summary: Business Central supports entering calculations and negative numbers directly into decimal fields, functioning like a mini calculator. This feature works with basic arithmetic operations and combined formulas for quantities and amounts, but only applies to decimal data types.
key_points: Decimal fields accept mathematical expressions like 19+19, 41-9, 12*4, or 12/4 that calculate automatically
Combined calculations work with parentheses like (2+3)*4 as long as there are no spaces in the formula
Negative numbers can be entered as -20.5 or 20.5- with the final operator determining the sign
Only decimal data type supports formulas; integer, text, and code fields do not
Integer fields support negative numbers but text and code fields store formulas as literal text

quotes.text: When entering numbers into these fields, you can enter the formula instead of the sum quantity.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability that decimal fields accept formulas rather than just static values

quotes.text: This can only be used for Decimal Data type.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the important limitation that this feature is restricted to decimal fields only

quotes.text: If the last character of the expression is a + or a - , the entire expression will be recorded with that sign.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the rule for how negative numbers are determined in suffix notation
